name: ci-watch
description: Watches a pushed PR's checks locally, shows progress on the status line, and wakes the session once when they settle.

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the PR checks are read with gh. Local only: no plan usage.

timeoutMinutes.title: Give up after (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A watch still pending after this long wakes the session with what is stuck.

deepTierPattern.title: Deep review checks (pattern)
deepTierPattern.description: Check names that belong to a slower deep review tier, so a faster review's failure waits for it: no early wake while one of these is still pending. A case-insensitive regular expression.
